candidate.definition_en: To show the way to a destination by going in front of or beside someone.
candidate.explanation_ar: تمشي قدام الناس عشان تدلهم على الطريق، أو تكون المسؤول عن مجموعة.

senses.definition_en: To show the way to a place by going in front of someone.
senses.definition_ar: يقود أو يرشد إلى مكان بالسير في المقدمة.
examples: Can you lead the way to the train station?

senses.definition_en: To be in charge of or manage a group, team, or activity.
senses.definition_ar: يقود أو يتولى إدارة فريق أو نشاط.
examples: She will lead the group during the museum tour.

senses.definition_en: To result in or cause a particular situation or outcome (lead to).
examples: Eating too much sugar can lead to health problems.
Can you lead the way to the train station?
She will lead the group during the museum tour.
Eating too much sugar can lead to health problems.
